authority: Project lead's bounded source extension under the existing autonomous CNY10000 research mandate; no independent approval claimed.
purpose: Resolve the already fixed 2013-2019 ETF source gap before one separately registered quarterly experiment. Does not reopen the paused annual fixed-exposure study or any closed candidate.

scope.calendar_policy: Reuse retained 2012-2014 and 2015-2025 CN calendars; no fresh calendar or 2026 ETF outcome retrieval.

requests.catalog: One SSE commonQuery.do request for510300, TITLE=年度报告, publication2014-01-01 through2020-04-01, page1,size100; require no truncation and exact report identity before downloading.
requests.pdf: At most one full annual PDF for each of the seven fixed report years, using URLs actually returned by the official catalog; prefer reuse if an identical source is already retained. No summaries, performance ranking or holdings extraction.
requests.price: One SSE dayk request, absolute begin/end indices derived from the frozen date-only response. Require exact date equality with the pre-fixed 2013-2019 calendar before using numerical fields.

on_failure: Retain the failed request and evidence gap. No silent replacement, retries, changed dates, or performance-based fallback. Independent later source evidence requires its own recorded scope.
